name: lol-desktop-native-root
description: Host dependency for the Zig build. build.zig resolves @native-sdk/cli from node_modules/ and drives the frontend through pnpm; this root package.json exists so both resolve from the repository root.

scripts.format: pnpm run format:frontend && pnpm run format:zig
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir frontend run format:check && zig fmt --check build.zig build.zig.zon src
scripts.check: pnpm run version:check && pnpm run bridge:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run frontend:typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run frontend:test
scripts.check:static: pnpm run version:check && pnpm run bridge:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run frontend:typecheck
